description: This Java class 'JpaApiKeyDao' implements data access object (DAO) for API keys, providing methods to find, delete, and manage API key entities in a database, using Spring Data JPA and custom utility classes.

classes.name: JpaApiKeyDao
classes.description: DAO class for managing ApiKey entities in the database, extending generic JPA DAO and implementing ApiKeyDao interface.

methods.name: findByValue
methods.description: Finds an ApiKey by its value.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves paginated ApiKeys associated with a specific tenant.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ApiKeys associated with a specific tenant and user.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes ApiKeys associated with a specific tenant.

methods.name: deleteByUserId
methods.description: Deletes ApiKeys associated with a specific user within a tenant.

methods.name: deleteAllByExpirationTimeBefore
methods.description: Deletes all ApiKeys with expiration time before a specified timestamp.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the JPA repository used for database operations.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is API_KEY.
